$comment: 物品圖示的生成清單。generate.py 依這份逐項送進 ComfyUI；prompt = prefix + subject + suffix。recolor：這張圖要在遊戲裡換色（metal/leather/cloth/wood/jewel/liquid），換色的部分在 subject 裡寫成 plain grey，後處理會把低彩度的像素對到 palette.json 的 ramp。for：這張圖給哪些物品用（說明用）。 hollow：物件中間有孔（戒指、項圈、鎖鏈），封閉的背景色區域也要去掉；沒標的（玻璃瓶）只去掉和邊緣相連的背景。
prefix: pixel art, pix_merge, game item icon, single object, centered, isolated,
suffix: , white background, simple background, limited palette, no people, no text
negative: lowres, blurry, jpeg artifacts, text, signature, watermark, username, worst quality, low quality, realistic, 3d, photo, smooth shading, anti-aliasing, multiple objects, cropped, hands, person
